product_one_liner.value: Blue Triangle helps product, eCommerce, marketing, and engineering teams connect digital friction to revenue, prioritize fixes, and measure the results.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists named plans, including Simple CSP, Competitive Index, and Enterprise; Enterprise uses custom pricing.

employee_band.notes: Revelio reports 30 employees worldwide as of March 2026; the company LinkedIn profile lists 21.

hq_location.notes: Glen Allen, Virginia, is listed by the company LinkedIn profile and PitchBook.

eng_blog.notes: The index contains product announcements, marketing, podcasts, and performance advice; it does not establish two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: The public help center contains multiple product guides and technical articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The job board reports no open roles as of November 9, 2026.

model_provider.notes: No provider powering the built-in AI Assistant was identified in the documentation, AI/security material, blog, or subprocessor list reviewed. MCP compatibility with external assistants does not establish its backend model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust center offers SOC-2 reports and ISO27001 documentation on request.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook and Millionrounds list November 2021; LinkedIn's funding widget instead lists December 2021. The round amount is not disclosed in the cited public records.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round listed by these sources occurred in November 2021, before the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The job board reports no open roles as of November 9, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: In July 2026, Blue Triangle announced its Revenue Assurance layer, described as its biggest platform update, with revenue-impact prioritization, AI-generated fixes, and ROI validation.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Emily Salzer's profile dates the start of her VP of Customer Success role to January 2026, following her Strategic Customer Success Director role. This was an internal leadership-role change, not an external hire.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Documented MCP workflows name these systems; this is a product-workflow signal, not confirmation of internal deployment. ZoomInfo is described as a manual cross-reference.
